title: UPC Representation
description: A typed rendering of a source. Many representations share one source. Bytes live at `path`; the record classifies them by `role` and carries role-specific extras (image description/ocr, pdf page_count, av duration). A textual representation (media_type text/*, application/json, application/xml) can carry verified quotations; char_count is in Unicode codepoints.

representation_id.description: rep-<12hex> (or img-<12hex> for images), = first 12 hex of the file's byte sha256.

media_type.description: IANA media type, e.g. text/html, application/pdf, text/markdown, image/png.

path.description: Corpus-relative, /-separated path. Must resolve inside the corpus root; portable filename rules apply (§10).

sha256.description: Hex sha256 of the exact stored file bytes (with or without the sha256: prefix).

description.description: For images: a machine-generated textual description (first-class, so a Markdown-only reader understands the figure).

encoding.description: Character encoding of the stored bytes for a raw capture; tool-produced text is UTF-8 (§02).

char_count.description: Unicode codepoint count of the UTF-8-decoded text (the char_range unit).

parent_representation_ref.description: For a representation extracted FROM another (an image pulled from a PDF, a transcript of an audio file).

duplicate_of.description: rep-id this representation is a byte-or-content duplicate of (advisory, §07).
